title: United ISD Parent Learning Summit set for Saturday at United High School
excerpt: United ISD's 2026 Parent Learning Summit takes place Saturday, November 14, from 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. at United High School, with sessions, guest speakers, breakfast and a kids' camp.
content:
United ISD is inviting all parents to its 2026 Parent Learning Summit on Saturday, November 14, from 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. at United High School.

The summit is a day of sessions and networking designed to help parents connect with the district's programs, resources and opportunities, and to strengthen partnerships between families and schools, according to KGNS.

Parents will be able to meet administrators, counselors and teachers, and attend sessions introducing them to what is going on in the district. Coffee and a light breakfast will be provided, guest speakers are featured, and a kids' camp will be offered for children.

Adriana Ramirez, United ISD's executive director of Federal and State Programs, said the event offers a positive atmosphere where parents can learn about different things happening in the district. She encouraged parents to register early, noting that spots are limited.

The district's Federal and State Programs department organizes the event. For more information, parents can call 956-473-6259.

Sources: KGNS, “United ISD 2026 Parent Learning Summit aims to connect parents with district resources, opportunities” (Nov. 12, 2026).
